title: Hackers probe newly disclosed flaws in Copeland refrigeration controllers
what_changed: Summary and plain said attackers began probing 'within a day' of disclosure and that the flaws let attackers recover administrator passwords, and gave 1,960 as VulnCheck's count. VulnCheck says the administrator code of the day is computable on firmware 5.8.8, exploitation was seen on 12 and 13 November after the CVE records went live, and 1,960 is Onyphe's count.
